name: Jarvis Approval Gate
description: Routes tool calls matching configured names/patterns through the Jarvis policy service for explicit operator approval. Uses OpenClaw's built-in requireApproval mechanism on the before_tool_call hook (no custom queueing).

policySvcUrl.description: Base URL of the Jarvis policy/approval service. Default: http://policy-svc:3036.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for operator approval before timing out (default: 300000 = 5 min). Hard ceiling: 600000ms (10 min, MAX_PLUGIN_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS).

timeoutBehavior.description: What to do on approval timeout (default: deny). Per Jarvis safety policy, default is deny — unattended approvals never auto-allow.

rules.description: Approval rules. Tool calls matching any rule require approval.

toolNamePattern.description: Regex pattern (matched against toolName) — alternative to exact toolName.

riskClass.description: Risk class label sent to the policy service for routing/UX.

title.description: Human-readable title shown in the approval prompt.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the approval prompt.

timeoutBehavior.label: On Timeout
timeoutBehavior.help: What to do if operator does not respond in time
